description: Aéroports d'Occitanie is a dataset listed in Occitanie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Cette couche géographique représente les 10 principaux aéroports de la région Occitanie. Coverage: Occitanie. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are aéroport, aérodrome, avion, transport. The portal shows 10 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-laregion-fr-portal.
